test_cases.title: Manage Roles and Create User pages load without saving anything
acs: DERIVED: /Admin/UserRoles.aspx shows h1 Manage Roles and /Admin/UserCreate.aspx shows h1 Create User - routes /Admin/UserRoles.aspx, /Admin/UserCreate.aspx
assumptions: The user is signed in with Windows integrated authentication and holds the admin role (project admin).
Data set (route -> h1): /Admin/UserRoles.aspx -> Manage Roles; /Admin/UserCreate.aspx -> Create User.
Pages are only opened and read. No user is created, no role is changed and no form is submitted.

steps.action: Open http://localhost:1946/Admin/MenuAdmin.aspx as a signed-in admin user.
steps.expected: The page loads with the h1 System Administration.
The page loads, the h1 reads Manage Roles and no server error page is shown.
The h1 still reads Manage Roles and no server error page is shown.
The page loads, the h1 reads Create User and no server error page is shown.

steps.action: Leave the Create User page without entering or saving any data.
steps.expected: No confirmation or saved message is shown and the h1 is still Create User.

test_cases.title: Internal Test Consultant Department page loads with its heading
acs: DERIVED: /Admin/TCDepartment.aspx shows h1 Internal Test Consultant Department - route /Admin/TCDepartment.aspx
assumptions: The user is signed in with Windows integrated authentication and holds the admin role (project admin).
The page is only opened and read. No department is added, changed or saved.

steps.action: Open http://localhost:1946/home.aspx as a signed-in admin user.
steps.expected: The page loads with the h1 Home.
The address path is /Admin/MenuAdmin.aspx and the h1 reads System Administration.
The page loads and the address path is /Admin/TCDepartment.aspx.

steps.action: Read the main heading of the page.
steps.expected: The h1 reads Internal Test Consultant Department.

steps.action: Check the page for a server error message.
steps.expected: No server error page is shown.

test_cases.title: Pricing plan pages load with their expected heading for each page
acs: DERIVED: /Admin/WeightedPricingPlan.aspx shows h1 Weighted Pricing Plan and /Admin/PostagePricingPlan.aspx shows h1 Postage Pricing Plan - routes /Admin/WeightedPricingPlan.aspx, /Admin/PostagePricingPlan.aspx
assumptions: The user is signed in with Windows integrated authentication and holds the admin role (project admin).
Data set (route -> h1): /Admin/WeightedPricingPlan.aspx -> Weighted Pricing Plan; /Admin/PostagePricingPlan.aspx -> Postage Pricing Plan.
Pages are only opened and read. No price is changed and nothing is saved.

steps.action: Open http://localhost:1946/Admin/MenuAdmin.aspx as a signed-in admin user.
steps.expected: The page loads with the h1 System Administration.
The page loads, the h1 reads Weighted Pricing Plan and no server error page is shown.

steps.action: Reload the Weighted Pricing Plan page.
steps.expected: The h1 still reads Weighted Pricing Plan and no server error page is shown.
The page loads, the h1 reads Postage Pricing Plan and no server error page is shown.

steps.action: Reload the Postage Pricing Plan page.
steps.expected: The h1 still reads Postage Pricing Plan and no server error page is shown.
